Revision 3 is not executable as reviewed: extract_initial_search_state, extract_search_state_after_consent and extract_product pass whole observation page collections into global extract. Their target is one object, so independent mapping cannot activate. This repeats the retained oversized-request failure. Merely narrowing descriptions is insufficient. Also captureComplete is model-derived and no requires guard enforces original manifest completeness.

Make a structural revision using only existing TaskPlan operations/bindings/each, preserving all six accepted requirements, the sole public query input, real per-product navigation, the write_products_xlsx operation and its filePath output, and unconditional close_browser_always. Do not remove work, create success literals, move cleanup or change limits.

Inside each existing snapshot-page-reading loop, after reading its actual page, add explicit independent extraction over that page's declared observation.records: mode extract, each:{input:<records input>,output:<sole candidates array field>}. Each source record returns one compact result, which may itself be an array of observed candidates; an empty array is allowed only after checking that record is irrelevant. Preserve outer item order, duplicates and nesting; never independently rank, truncate or choose ten products per page. Complete bounded records, not whole page collections, are generation examples. Keep relevant observed dialog/group context, texts and exact action references needed for the corresponding decision. The authoritative record fields include kind, tag, selector, group, text, href, role; select only needed consumer fields, preserving their declared nullability. Do not generate invented labels, statuses, booleans or numerical ranks inside source-grounded extraction. Do not copy every irrelevant record under another name. Export the compact candidate arrays through the page loop.

Global classification/selection is explicit interpret over those compact candidates and narrowly selected shared context only: decide whether authorized cookie consent is actually present, distinguish blockers, choose at most the first ten product links globally in source order, and select observed product fields. Do not pass raw pages or whole MCP envelopes redundantly. Preserve context needed for correctness; if it cannot fit, report a limitation. Product name/description/price must come from the actual visited product's observations; null/explicit missing status is permitted, invented observations and search-summary substitution are not.

Completeness is deterministic: guard each manifest-consuming loop with requires checking the original observationManifest.captureTruncated and manifestTruncated are false; guard consumed pages' captureTruncated as necessary. Read every manifest page before any click or navigation invalidates its cursors. nextCursor on an individual fixed page is satisfied by consuming all manifest pages; do not require every nonfinal page to have no continuation. Use a bounded maxRecords request (100) for manifests and existing maxItems 100, keeping original producer caps. Do not ask an LLM to manufacture captureComplete. If capture cannot be complete under these bounds, stop explicitly before downstream extraction/publication and retain cleanup.

Keep explicit conditional clicking only for an observed authorized consent control, followed by a fresh snapshot. Keep product maxItems 10 sequentially and actual visits. Do not emit a fabricated rank-0 product for CAPTCHA: observed blockers remain explicit failed work, not a successful substitute workbook. Ordinary assembly uses typed bindings where possible. Final formatting may remain explicit interpretation over the already compact verified product records, never raw observations. No new inputs, schema assumptions, permission changes, scripts or executor names in TaskPlan. Return the complete revised plan with accepted requirements unchanged.
